title: מגפון הנאום הארוך

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: enamel 5, brass 3, steel 3, ribbon 3, note 2, ivory 2, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (art/chars/weapons/w4/tools/speech_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, the mark stamped upright after the turn, a 1 px outline
character:
WHO: a dented red enamel megaphone that loves the sound of itself: a brass lip, a ceremony ribbon wrapped twice round
       its horn and tied in a bow, speech notes taped to its bell, an ON AIR lamp, and the speech itself: a paper
       concertina that hangs out of its back and never ends.
  IDLE: it cannot keep quiet: by itself it squeals a short feedback (the lip shivers, the lamp blinks), then gives one
        small "ahem" and stops. HELD (fire): the lip pumps with every word, the notes flap, the ribbon streams, the
        speech unfolds page after page; everyone nearby sits down and listens.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 18 ticks: it comes up and forward from the hip, overshoots; at tick 8 he taps the mic: tap, tap (the lip thumps twice, the lamp answers), then it is live

idle.note: 150 ticks: it hangs quiet, the notes and the speech swaying; then by itself a short FEEDBACK squeal (the lip shivers three times, the lamp blinks); a pause; one small 'ahem' (it lifts a little, one cough of the lip), and it stops, embarrassed

fire.note: 12 ticks, not marked loop: the sim starts the act again every 12 ticks while he holds the speech, so it chains (anticipation and shot on tick 0, ready on 12). The first word jolts it (the lip thrown out two pixels, the horn bucks five degrees and gives two pixels), then it pumps a word every 4 ticks: the notes flap, the ribbon's tails stream back, the speech unfolds another page

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click: the lamp is dark, the whole speech hangs out of it, read to the end; one last dry croak of the lip; at 6 he tosses it away in front of him (three tumbling frames)

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch (catch.json has the body's frames): it lands in his hands with a squeal (one pump), the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the made-in-Israel mark as a ROUNDEL on the bell's flank (a calm flat place of 14 x 17 px, the bell's own shape, nothing bent to hold it): the blue interlaced outline star 9 x 9 on an ivory disc, its ring the enamel's own dark step; stamped upright after the turn, whole in every row, clear of both fists
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the tag with its line, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the 9 x 9 star; atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.draw: the megaphone comes up from the hip (arsenal.json equip 0)
events.tap_mic: he taps the mic: tap, tap (equip 8): two thumps
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick
events.anticipation: the 1-tick squash, on the shot's own tick (fire 0)
events.shot: the first word leaves the bell (fire 0): the sound cone starts at `muzzle`
events.click: the trigger on a dead megaphone (empty 0)
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

cells: the ribbon in a heap on the floor
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is its ribbon: on the catch it sags, then lies in a heap.
